title: The review tab's snapshot
description: What `ingestion tui --view review --json` prints: each item that waits on a person, ordered by the board's default grouping, the digit that places on each destination, and how each read stands. A change to its shape bumps schema_version.

taken_at.description: When the snapshot was taken, in UTC.

grouping.description: The board's default grouping, which orders the items. A display the person left grouped otherwise does not change it.

destinations.description: Each destination a digit places on, in the order the set in force declares them, up to nine. Null where the queue came without its destinations or was not read.

group.description: The key of the group the item draws under, such as reason/quality-review.

source.description: What the row's first column names: a field of the item's source, such as r/<subreddit>, or else its connectors.

sources.description: Each read the tab makes, as its last read left it.

unread_sources.description: The reads with no good answer yet, so an empty items list is unknown rather than empty.
